title: PMW Plus
description: PMW Plus adds helpful new systems to Protomanly's Weather
body:
# **PMW Plus**
PMW Plus makes using PMW faster and easier by makeing easy to use menu's for spawning natural disasters via PMW.

Check out my [YT Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@Sammythegamer12/featured)

Features:
- 5 pages with spawn menu's and more
- Compatability with many PMW addons
- Spawn Tornado
- Spawn Firewhirl
- Spawn Wildfire
- Spawn Supercell
- Spawn Squall
- Spawn Cyclone
- Fun codes to mess around with
- Helpful tips and info on the mod
- Easy ways to trigger events in PMW addons
- An emergency bunker structure (Can be spawned using menu)
- Support for upcoming PMW updates
- Quick clear command
- Challenge Mode (Only works with cheats and if the gamerule is enabled)

Misc Features:
- 2 Tornado Paintings
- Tornadic Force Potion

Theese systems allow you to quickly spawn and do many other functions just by clicking V.

How to use:
1. Click V to open menu
2. Enter a valid Stage / Rating for a disaster
3. Click spawn ... to spawn the disaster

CLIENT: The mod works in client only when you have the rank you need to execute a PMW command

CLIENT LAN: The mod works for any player with OP / Creative (You can check by trying to run the PMW command)

PRO SERVER: Everything works for server admins / OPs

Recomended File:
Latest available version

Dependencies:
This mod NEEDS Protomanly's Weather to work!

Description:
PMW Plus allows you to simply manage PMW easier with the many tools that it adds. It also allows you to create "fun" tornadoes and more cool things like cyclones. This mod does not add any new things to PMW like the EAS addon does but it just allows you to do things without having to enter a long command. I made this mod cause i thought it took to long to type; /pmweather spawn tornado 100 360 so i made a easier and quicker way to do that in this mod.

Updates: Most updates will come out when the PMW mod updates so we have to add new spawn options.

Forge availability: A little while ago PMWeather got ported to 1.20.1 forge, I do plan to make a version that works with the port at some point.

Disclaimer: [PMWeather Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/pmweather-plus) is not at all assosiated with this mod and adds compltely different features!

Compatability: This mod can work with 4 other addons including PMWeather API for developement purposes (FYI It is compatiable with all other mods).

Spoilers:

### Dev Mode:
### 
Dev Mode allows you to use the addon PMWeather API or just PMW alone to run some important Dev functions.

You can use dev mode by running the command /pmwdev console open.
